⚡ **Protocol Call Resources:**

🔗 **Zoom**: Custom meeting link (see issue description)
✅ **Calendar**: [View](https://calendar.google.com/calendar/embed?src=c_upaofong8mgrmrkegn7ic7hk5s%40group.calendar.google.com&ctz=UTC&mode=AGENDA&dates=20260527%2F20260528&showTitle=1&showCalendars=0&showTabs=0&showPrint=0&showNav=0) | [Add to Calendar](https://www.google.com/calendar/render?action=TEMPLATE&text=EIPIP+Meeting+%23126%2C+May+27%2C+2026&dates=20260527T160000Z%2F20260527T170000Z&details=Issue%3A+https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2Fethereum%2Fpm%2Fissues%2F2062)
✅ **Discourse**: [Discussion Topic](https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/28553)

I'd like to present an update on my work for the EIPs [working group](https://github.com/eips-wg), including for the multi-repo local build system I presented last meeting.

Since Sam Wilson reviewed the v1 of that system and offered feedback to improve it, I've since completed a v2... the first part is already merged, while the rest is still under review. The new central coordinating issue is here: [v2 multi-repo local build system](https://github.com/eips-wg/preprocessor/issues/15)

I'd also like to share a few new features recently completed that are still pending review:
- [Hardforks page](https://github.com/eips-wg/preprocessor/issues/35) (I know there's a big demand and long wait for this)
- [Full text search](https://github.com/eips-wg/preprocessor/issues/39) across the entire EIP corpus (powered by Pagefind)
- [Revamped site navigation system](https://github.com/eips-wg/theme/pull/9) for desktop and mobile

**I have a fully operational live demo site showcasing all the above (and more):**
[wg-eips.ritovision.com](https://wg-eips.ritovision.com/)

**As a bonus:** the EIPs search system can also produce build artifacts for third-party consumers, including vector-database-ready corpus chunks for semantic search. As a demonstrated use case, I have a [working repo](https://github.com/ritovision/eips-vector-mcp) that uses the chunked EIPs corpus to create an MCP server, allowing AI agents to retrieve EIP context directly.

~~I only just learned about this meeting tomorrow, so I'll do my best to put a presentation together on short notice.~~ I'll keep it light, give a walkthrough of the current demo and explain how the pieces fit together.

Update:
Okay meeting is moved to the 27th now so I guess there's more time to plan.

Thanks again for giving me the room to walk through this today.

I did lose track of time and did not expect it to last so long... I was ad-libbing and didn't have more concise explanations prepared so I tried to be thorough.

I also missed some comments/questions coming in while I was presenting. I appreciate the engagement, and I’ll be more mindful next time about keeping time tighter and watching the thread so I can respond to questions as they come up.

With that said, I don't think another meeting is needed to go over the progress here. More than enough was covered. It would be best to revisit a future presentation / demo after the reviewed features have been finalized.
